CommunityApplications.Profile:
Unraid SecretGuard is a security-focused Unraid plugin that helps identify likely passwords, API keys, tokens and other credentials stored in Docker templates.
SecretGuard can move selected credentials out of flash-stored XML templates into protected env files or an encrypted Vault, while keeping the Docker configuration usable.
This repository contains the SecretGuard plugin and Community Applications metadata.
For support, bug reports and feature requests, use the Unraid forum support thread or GitHub Issues.
SecretGuard is currently Public Beta.
